name: per-story-files-hash-material-drift
title: Add a secondary storyFilesHash so unrelated main merges stop staling a story's bindings
description: Root-cause fix for the recurring re-establish-after-unrelated-merge churn: keep the whole-tree materialHash, but ADD a secondary storyFilesHash (story's own changed files vs merge-base main). Bindings stay valid while storyFilesHash is unchanged; whole-tree drift downgrades from instant-reject to a re-attestation-REQUIRED warning (never silent rebind, never story-diff-only). Load-bearing soundness work; decision-doc first.
